name: JADX resource export
command: cd ~/.local/share/open-teams-android && nix build nixpkgs#jadx --out-link jadx && export JAVA_HOME=$PWD/jdk17 && JAVA_OPTS=-Xmx12g ./jadx/bin/jadx --no-src -d res-export apk/com.microsoft.teams@arm64-v8a.apk > analysis/jadx-res.log 2>&1; tail -3 analysis/jadx-res.log; ls res-export/resources | head
